manager.bridge.intro.message: The bridge lets a local script drive TbSync through a loopback HTTP socket, for automated testing. It is off until you switch it on here, and it stops when Thunderbird does. This feature exists only in the GitHub beta build. It is not part of the release published on addons.thunderbird.net.

manager.bridge.downloadHint.message: To enable the bridge, install its small helper app first: download it, run the install script it contains, then restart Thunderbird.

manager.bridge.target.none.hint.message: Choose an account and a resource: without them the bridge refuses every command that changes anything or reads calendar data.

manager.bridge.stale.message: The installed helper app is out of date. Download it again and re-run the install script, then switch the bridge off and on.

manager.bridge.detail.failed.message: The helper kept failing to start. Disable and re-enable to try again, or reinstall the helper.

manager.bridge.detail.socketDead.message: TbSync's link is alive but the helper's HTTP socket is not answering.

manager.bridge.detail.linkDead.message: The helper app answers, but its link to TbSync is down - requests will hang.
